component.name: canvast
component.summary: An endless canvas for drawing and references, offline

description.p: Your references, drawings and notes in one place: a creative workspace on an endless canvas. It works offline, with no account.

ul.li: Reference boards: pictures, video, PDFs and 3D models on a canvas, cropped, flipped and adjusted without touching the files
Drawing and vector editing: pressure pens, shapes, Bézier paths, boolean shapes, masks, gradients, patterns and guides
Comics and storyboards: pages cut into panels, speech balloons, rich text with your own fonts
A library of your files in folders and tags, with a viewer and a search that knows sizes, colours and dates
Linked markdown notes, and Pins: a canvas or a folder in a window above every view
Your workspace is a plain folder any sync tool can carry; hidden items are encrypted
